## 0. AMD Q3 (reported 2026-11-03)

- Q3 revenue was $13.4B, above the high end of guidance. Data Center was $8.5B, up 97%. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000002488/000000248826000188/q32026991.htm
- Q4 guide is about $17B ±3%, against $16.23B expected. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.benzinga.com/markets/earnings/26/11/62845344/amd-posts-q3-double-beat-as-data-center-segment-shines-growth-expected-to-accelerate-in-q4
- On the call, Su said data center AI was better than expected and guided Q4 data center up 50% sequentially. AMD expects data center to be more than 80% of 2027 revenue. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-amd-tops-q3-2026-estimates-as-stock-jumps-after-hours-93CH-4996894
- Su expects server revenue to double in 2027. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/amd-amd-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html
- Reaction: shares rose about 8% after hours. CoreWeave and Nebius rallied. The stock had sold off on overspending fears. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/amd-amd-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html
- Shares were down about 25% over the prior month, so the move is a partial rebound. — 2026-11-03 — https://www.chartmill.com/news/AMD/Chartmill-57632-Advanced-Micro-Devices-NASDAQAMD-Q3-2026-Earnings-Data-Center-Nearly-Doubles-and-Guidance-Tops-Consensus
- The excerpts I retrieved had no "pacing" or "digestion" wording. I did not read the full transcript.

## 1. AI-lab financing

- FT: OpenAI cut its round target to about $20B from $30B, and its valuation to $1.25T from $1.4T. The first close is expected below $20B after investors trimmed allocations. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/openai-slashes-funding-target-by-10-billion-amid-tech-rout-ft-reports-oct-30-4990653
- Anthropic filed an S-1. — 2026-10-26 — https://www.forbes.com/sites/guneyyildiz/2026/11/02/openai-cuts-round-to-20-billion-as-uae-investors-pair-capital-with-compute-capacity/
- Neocloud financing: nothing new beyond the credit items below.

## 2. Credit

- Microsoft priced $25B, its first bond sale since 2017, with about $115B of orders. The 2066 tranche priced at +105bp. — 2026-10-29 — https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/30/microsoft-is-borrowing-25-billion-for-ai-its-first-bond-sale-since-2017/
- Oracle filed to sell $10B of stock and $10B of notes. — 2026-11-02 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/oracle-files-to-sell-20-billion-in-new-stock-bonds-to-finance-ai-buildout.html
- Oracle 5-year CDS was 292bp, per the same article. — 2026-11-02 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/oracle-files-to-sell-20-billion-in-new-stock-bonds-to-finance-ai-buildout.html
- Another source puts Oracle CDS at about 296bp. — 2026-11-02 — https://beinsure.com/news/oracle-stock-price-forecast-20bn-ai-financing-raises-debt-and-dilution-risks/
- CoreWeave's 9.75% 2031 notes last traded at 79.75, a 15.83% yield. — 2026-11-02 — https://fourweekmba.com/ai-coreweaves-7-75b-of-dollar-bonds-now-trade-near-6-3b/ (aggregator quoting FINRA TRACE)
- Pimco halved its Meta and Oracle Michigan data-center bond stakes. It also passed on the Broadcom/Anthropic deal and SoftBank's junk bond. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/pimco-cuts-meta-and-oracle-debt-holdings-amid-ai-bond-market-correction

## 3. Suppliers

- Intel Q3: data center revenue was $7.3B, up 78%. Substrate, memory and wafer shortages limit supply. Intel's Q4 revenue guide is $1B–2B below estimates. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/intel-foundry-faces-critical-test-after-stocks-45percent-plunge-in-october.html
- Intel's stock fell 29% the next day. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/amd-amd-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html (the AMD article above; URL is /2026/11/03/…)
- Foxconn's chairman said capacity is booked for at least 18 months. He called demand "quite strong." — 2026-10-30 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/hon-hai-technology-group-foxconn-ai-server-young-liu-.html
- Nvidia, Broadcom, Micron, TSMC, Vertiv, Arista, Credo, Astera and Celestica: no new guidance found in this window. Insider selling: nothing found.

## 4. Physical build-out

- Prometheus Hyperscale pulled out of a gigawatt-scale Casper, Wyoming project. The landowners say it may continue. — 2026-11-02 — https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/prometheus-hyperscale-pulls-out-of-gigawatt-scale-data-center-project-in-casper-wyoming/
- Microsoft exited the Nscale Loughton, UK project over grid delays. — date unknown — https://www.networkworld.com/article/4238599/microsoft-exits-uk-ai-data-center-project-over-electricity-delays.html
- Energy North dropped the June 2028 first-power date for its 1GW Project Ares in Australia. — date unknown — https://tech-insider.org/australian-outback-data-centre-project-ares-timeline-pulled-2026/
- GPU rental prices: the Silicon Data neocloud H100 index was $2.88/hr, about 44% above December. — 2026-10-24 — https://explainx.ai/blog/nvidia-h100-gpu-rental-price-45-percent-since-december-silicon-data-chamath-claimed-vs-verified-2026

- Microsoft's Azure grew 48%, its commercial backlog is $677B, and it guides Q2 capex above $50B. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.datastudios.org/post/microsoft-q1-fy27-results-azure-48-percent-33-2-billion-capex-45-2-billion

assessment.headline: AMD's strong guide offsets AI credit stress as Oracle CDS reaches 292bp and AI project bonds weaken.
assessment.digest_markdown:
**What changed this week**

- **AMD reassured on demand.** Q3 revenue was $13.4B, and data center revenue rose 97% to $8.5B. Lisa Su expects server revenue to double in 2027, and the shares rose about 8% after hours.
- **Foxconn sees long visibility.** It says its capacity is booked for at least 18 months.
- **Intel's miss is about supply, not demand.** Its weak Q4 guide reflects substrate, memory and wafer shortages.
- **Hyperscaler plans stay large.** Alphabet expects 2027 capex above $300B. Microsoft guides fiscal 2027 capex of about $170B and says it will stay free-cash-flow positive.

**Where the stress is**

The pressure is in financing.

- Oracle filed to raise $10B in stock and $10B in notes, and its default-insurance cost (CDS) sits at 292-296bp.
- CoreWeave's 2031 bonds reportedly trade near 79.75 cents on the dollar. That figure is not yet confirmed by a major source.
- Pimco halved its holdings of AI data-center bonds.
- OpenAI's smaller round has still not closed.

In short, the strongest companies can borrow easily, while leveraged AI players are paying more. Microsoft's first bond sale since 2017 drew about $115B of orders.

**Markets**

The Nasdaq-100 is down about 10% over four weeks, the VIX is above 21, and Brent crude is at $123. High-yield spreads widened to 3.43%. Four of the five hyperscalers now have negative free cash flow, so they increasingly depend on debt markets.

**Why it matters**

Demand signals from chipmakers and server builders are still strong. The risk is that funding gets costlier before demand slows, with the first hit landing on neoclouds and AI labs.

**Watch next**

- How Oracle's notes price.
- CoreWeave bond prices.
- Whether OpenAI completes its first close.

*Not investment advice.*
